security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: OpenSBI M-mode critical section after mnstatus.NMIE clear missing interrupt masking check|HSM suspend saves Smrnmi CSRs without verifying mnstatus.NMIE disable|MNRET restore path writes mnepc without IALIGN masking per mnepc.WARL
security_spec.summary: OpenSBI M-mode firmware must save/restore Smrnmi CSRs atomically with mnstatus.NMIE=0 to prevent interrupt re-entry races during context switches
